en:
The film's story centers around Toron, an infant Tyrannosaurus who lost his mother Sera and father Zesta. Left alone, Toron embarks on a journey and meets friends, learning about true strength and courage, and what love truly means.



(Source: Anime News Network)
ja: あなたをずっとあいしてる

items.title: Я очень тебя люблю
items.alt: Gonyeoseog Masnagessda 2: Hamkkelaseo Haengboghae / You Are Umasou 2, Tasty 2: Happy Together, あなたをずっとあいしてる
